knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The power is isolated first. The intake and impeller are then checked, as the manufacturer directs, before any other part is changed.
Chlorine and chloramine in tap water can harm the bacteria that the filter depends on, so media is rinsed in water removed from the tank.
Pump replacement and rewiring are outside general maintenance. The correct response refers the work to a licensed person and records the request.

practicalCriteria: Learner isolates a canister or skimmer pump on a training set-up, proves it off, and only then opens the housing
Learner records the flow and the skimmer cup level before and after cleaning, with the readings written in the record
Learner writes a referral note for a simulated pump replacement request, with the symptoms and the readings
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark. With three questions, all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is assessed separately by observation and is not verified by this quiz.
evidenceRequired: Isolation record with the proving step
Pre-work and post-work flow and skimmer readings
Referral note for the pump replacement request
Assessor observation of isolation before the housing is opened
stopWorkCriteria: Any lid or housing opened while the pump is still connected to power
Biological media rinsed in tap water
Replacement of a pump or change of wiring by a person without a licence
